question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Enraged
solution:
The correct answer is: **Furious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enraged"** means extremely angry or furious, often to the point of losing control. (क्रोधित)

 
 
• **Example:** The customer was enraged after receiving a damaged product.
 
 
 
• **"Furious"** is a synonym for enraged, and it also means extremely angry or full of rage. (उग्र)
 
 
• **Example:** She was furious when she found out that her plans were canceled at the last minute.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **'Enraged'** is **'Furious'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Furious**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sharp** (तेज़): Having a keen edge or being very quick-witted.

 
 
• **Example:** The knife is very sharp and cuts through vegetables easily.
 
 
 
• **Jealous** (ईर्ष्यालु): Feeling resentment or envy towards someone else's success or possessions.
 
 
• **Example:** He was jealous of his brother's achievements.
 
 
 
• **Synthetic** (कृत्रिम): Something made by chemical synthesis, especially to imitate a natural product.
 
 
• **Example:** Synthetic materials are often used in manufacturing clothing.
